description: Maps a repository origin, repository name, or workspace path for non-repo folders to the ACS billing project code used on invoices. Edit this file by hand; copilot-credit-rollup.py reads it and stamps billing_code onto every repository grouping in the generated summary. An entry with a null billing_code is known but not yet assigned a code.
matching: Normalized repo_origin is matched first, then repo_name, then workspace_path. HTTPS, SSH, and scp-style remotes for the same host and path normalize to one origin. Unmatched records are reported under unmapped_repositories in the summary.
